name: claude-session-restore
description: Offers to reopen the Claude Code sessions (terminal and chat panel) that were running when a VS Code window last closed or crashed.

commands.title: Claude Session Restore: Restore Sessions from Last Run
Claude Session Restore: Show Tracked Sessions
Claude Session Restore: Check Compatibility with Claude Code

claudeRestore.promptOnStartup.description: On startup, offer to reopen Claude sessions that were running in this window when it last closed or crashed. Nothing is reopened without asking.

claudeRestore.includeChatPanel.description: Also track sessions in the Claude Code chat panel. They are reopened in the panel, not in a terminal.

claudeRestore.snapshotIntervalSeconds.description: How often the sessions running in this window are recorded.

claudeRestore.resumeCommand.description: Command typed into the new terminal to resume a terminal session. ${sessionId} is replaced with the session's id.

claudeRestore.sourceFolder.description: Folder of this extension's source code. "Investigate with Claude" opens Claude Code there when a compatibility problem is found. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

scripts.test: esbuild src/health.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/health.test-build.js && esbuild src/tracker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/tracker.test-build.js && node --test test/tracker.test.js test/health.test.js test/hook.test.js
